units: metres; glTF frame: up +y, front +z, +x the car's left; origin on the ground midway between the axles

spin.note: wheel_*.rotation.x += distance_m / radius_m (front 0.338 m, rear 0.376 m)

steer.note: steer_*.rotation.y = angle; pivot is the vertical through the wheel centre (the kingpin is not published)

door_l.note: quaternion from axis-angle: angle 0 shut, openDeg open. The hinge is not published (spec.md, "Doors").

door_r.note: quaternion from axis-angle: angle 0 shut, openDeg open. The hinge is not published (spec.md, "Doors").
